Britain’s Got Talent: The Ultimate Magician
videos.overview: Britain’s Got Talent: The Ultimate Magician showcases the very best magicians from Got Talent shows globally, as we see Britain’s Got Talent favourites competing against the very best magic acts from around the world.  Stephen Mulhern will host this special edition of Britain’s Got Talent with Amanda Holden, Alesha Dixon and David Walliams returning to the famous judging desk. For this one-off special edition, they will be joined by Las Vegas legend Penn Jillette – of Penn & Teller fame.  Ten magical acts will perform, and the winner will be chosen by the theatre audience – but who will be crowned the Ultimate Magician and take away the £50,000 prize?

videos.title: Semi Finals 5
videos.overview: Ant and Dec present the last of the live semi-final shows, as eight acts perform in front of judges Piers Morgan, Amanda Holden and Simon Cowell, as well a live studio audience. Which two acts will viewers vote to go through to Saturday’s finals?

videos.title: Final
videos.overview: After a week of highs and lows in the semi-final rounds, ten acts have made it through to the final of the competition. Each act performs one last routine for judges Simon Cowell, Amanda Holden and Piers Morgan, before the public vote for the overall winner of Britain’s Got Talent 2008.

videos.title: Final - The Results
videos.overview: Ant and Dec announce which act has been crowned 2008 champion, taking the huge cash prize and a slot in the Royal Variety Performance along with the title.

videos.title: Auditions 2
videos.overview: The auditions continue, with more from the best and worst talent in the country. Thousands of hopefuls of every age and background are out to win the grand prize of 100,000 pounds and a chance to strut their stuff at this year’s Royal Variety Performance. Judges Simon Cowell, Piers Morgan and Amanda Holden must sift through the wannabes and decide their fate. Ant and Dec are on hand to support the acts before and after they face the panel.

videos.title: Auditions 1
videos.overview: The one and only, Britain’s Got Talent, is back and celebrating ten triumphant years of talent. The dream team of judges - Simon Cowell, Amanda Holden, Alesha Dixon and David Walliams - once again take their places on the panel, in search of the most astonishing and exhilarating talent around. They are joined by the nation’s favourite TV duo, Ant & Dec, who will be on hand to encourage, congratulate and commiserate the acts whilst guiding the audience through the auditions. Together they have scoured the country looking for a winning act who can entertain the nation and capture the hearts and imaginations of the Great British public.

videos.title: Live Final
videos.overview: The eleventh series of Britain's Got Talent comes to a close tonight with its spectacular live finale. The lucky winner will be crowned the 11th champion of Britain's Got Talent, securing a life changing cash prize of £250,000 and a spot at this year's Royal Variety Performance. Who will be crowned the winner? It's over to Britain to decide.
